start: Live workout with ticked sets only, finished right after the last set

steps.action: Tap Finish on the workout screen
user_sees: Sheet 'Finish workout?' with a line of what will be saved (sets, time) and buttons 'Finish workout' and 'Keep going'
must_not: Paused time counted in the shown time
Numbers changing while the sheet is open

steps.action: Type a name (up to 60 letters) and a note in 'Note (optional)' ('How did it go?')
user_sees: The typed text in the boxes
must_not: Text over 60 / 500 letters silently saved cut without the box stopping it

user_sees: The button shows it is busy, then the workout-finished screen
must_not: Two workouts saved
The sheet closing as if saved when the save failed

start: Live workout with ticked sets and two unticked rows

user_sees: A question about the unticked sets (working sets and warm-ups counted apart) with 'Leave them out' picked
must_not: Unticked rows saved by default

user_sees: The overview line grows; the end time moves to 'Now' unless the workout has been open over 3 hours
must_not: Warm-ups alone moving the end time

user_sees: Ticked and unticked rows are saved
must_not: Unticked rows left out after choosing 'Save them'

start: Live workout left open long after the last tick

steps.action: Tap Finish an hour after the last set
user_sees: 'Open for <time>. When did you finish?' with 'Ended at <hh:mm>' picked and 'Now'
must_not: The end time set to now by default
A 12-hour clock when the phone uses 24-hour

user_sees: The saved workout ends at the suggested time
must_not: The duration counting the idle hour

start: Live workout that the app paused by itself

user_sees: A line about the paused span and a 'Count it' button
must_not: The paused time silently dropped with no way to count it

user_sees: The time shown grows by the paused span
must_not: Paused time counted twice

start: Live workout with no sets at all

user_sees: The main button reads 'Tick a set to finish' and is greyed
must_not: An empty workout saved

user_sees: The sheet closes; the workout carries on
must_not: The workout discarded

user_sees: The workout stays open with the banner: 'It's still open: free some space, then tap Finish again.'
must_not: A finished message for a save that failed
Sets lost

start: Live workout with only unticked sets

user_sees: 'Save them' is picked by itself, so there is something to save
must_not: 'Tick a set to finish' while unticked sets exist

steps.action: Tap 'Keep going', tick a set, tap Finish again
user_sees: The choice resets to 'Leave them out'; name and note boxes are empty again
must_not: The old choice or old note carried into the new opening

start: Finishing a workout while signed in and in a gym

user_sees: The workout and note go to the member's own cloud copy; the gym sees only what 'What my gym can see' lists
must_not: The note sent to the gym
A workout on demo data sent anywhere
